resources.string: Scrollable personal note with private stickers, colorful glow, and custom backgrounds.
%1$d private stickers · remove with the text

Long-press an empty home screen spot → Widgets → 小小筆記. Choose a note, then long-press to resize.

Text tools: select text to apply colors, rainbow, or glow. With no selection, the effect applies to the whole note. Background fade only affects the background.

Built-in sticker source: SigStick Hololive Walfie GIF plus 2021 (credited to Walfie -K). Character rights belong to their respective owners. This is an unofficial app. The asset license chain has not been independently verified; these materials are for this private version only.
